title: Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Raffled Off a Free Chanel Handbag at Their Wedding: Here’s Who Won
summary: The accessory retails for more than $6,000.
contentText:
One of the most surprising details to emerge from Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ‘s wedding was that the couple gave away free raffle prizes during the celebration, including a Chanel handbag — and the winner of the luxury accessory has now come forward to share their good fortune.

In a post on Instagram on Monday night (July 6) — three days after the couple’s extravagant nuptials — Jackie Tranquill, who is married to Kelce’s teammate Drue Tranquill, shared a photo of the Chanel purse The snap — which she has since removed from the carousel post — also included Jackie’s hand holding up her winning raffle ticket with the pop star and Kansas City Chiefs tight end’s custom monogram.

“Congrats to the newly weds,” she wrote in the caption, also sharing snaps of the floral dress she wore to the wedding. “WHAT A WEEKEND, WHAT A TIME TO BE ALIVE.”

The purse appears to be a Chanel 25 mini handbag , which retails for $6,400 on the legacy brand’s website. It was just one of the luxury prizes Swift and Kelce gave away at the Friday (July 3) celebration at Madison Square Garden, with insiders previously revealing that attendees could win raffle tickets by playing various games on site to enter into the giveaways. Another prize was apparently a 1970s Chevrolet Chevelle , similar to the model Swift and Kelce drove away in together after the 14-time Grammy winner’s first visit to Arrowhead Stadium when they started dating in 2023.

Other surprises included the news that Adam Sandler officiated the ceremony, and that Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks both performed during the reception. The NYC venue — which displayed “JUST&T MARRIED” signs on the screens outside after the couple tied the knot — was reportedly decorated to look like a secret garden with pictures of Swift and Kelce lining the hall guests entered through.

The wedding took place just two weeks after the Eras headliner notched her 15th career Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hit with “I Knew It, I Knew You” for the Toy Story 5 soundtrack. Her most recent album, The Life of a Showgirl , spent 12 weeks atop the Billboard 200 .
